description: This Java test file contains unit tests for the ServiceContext class within the OpenMRS API framework. It tests exception handling and module service setup functionalities.

classes.name: ServiceContextTest
classes.description: Unit testing class for ServiceContext, focusing on exception handling and module service configuration.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and sets up the ServiceContext before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Restores the original state after each test.

methods.name: getModuleOpenmrsServices_shouldRaiseApiExceptionWithNonExistentClass
methods.description: Tests that setting a module service with a non-existent class throws an APIException with an appropriate message and cause.

methods.name: getModuleOpenmrsServices_shouldRaiseApiExceptionWithNullClass
methods.description: Tests that setting a module service with a null class string throws an APIException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: getModuleOpenmrsServices_shouldRaiseApiExceptionWithNullClassInstance
methods.description: Tests that setting a module service with a valid class name but null class instance throws an APIException.
